title: Integrating Heterogeneous Echocardiography AI Outputs in Language Space: Learnable Late Fusion with a Supervised LLM
abstract: arXiv:2610.39464v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: View- and target-specific echocardiography AI models capture useful but complementary information and may not achieve sufficient predictive performance in isolation. A learned ensemble is a natural way to combine these outputs, but heterogeneous models typically require each output to be converted into a binary decision, probability, confidence score, or fixed-length feature vector. We developed a supervised large language model (LLM)-based late-fusion module that directly aggregates view-specific predicted finding statements and predicted measurements in language space and learns a case-level fusion function. In patient-level three-fold cross-validation of 859 examinations from 646 patients, the proposed method integrated heterogeneous outputs within a single framework, performed comparably to the best-performing reference strategy evaluated, and outperformed a general-purpose LLM without task-specific training. translated_title: 在语言空间中整合异构超声心动图AI输出：基于监督式大语言模型的可学习后期融合
translated_abstract: 针对不同视角和目标的超声心动图AI模型能够捕获有用但互补的信息，单独使用时可能无法达到足够的预测性能。学习型集成是组合这些输出的自然方式，但异构模型通常需要将每个输出转换为二元决策、概率、置信度分数或固定长度的特征向量。我们开发了一个基于监督式大语言模型（LLM）的后期融合模块，该模块直接在语言空间中聚合特定视角的预测发现陈述和预测测量值，并学习病例级别的融合函数。在对来自646名患者的859项检查进行的患者级别三折交叉验证中，所提出的方法在单一框架内整合了异构输出，其性能与所评估的最佳参考策略相当，并优于未经任务特定训练的通用大语言模型。这些结果表明……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于监督式大语言模型的可学习后期融合模块，直接在语言空间中整合异构超声心动图AI输出的预测陈述与测量值，其性能与最佳参考策略相当且优于未经任务训练的通用LLM。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a supervised LLM-based learnable late-fusion module that directly integrates heterogeneous echocardiography AI outputs in language space, achieving performance comparable to the best reference strategy and outperforming a general-purpose LLM without task-specific training.
